diffs.diff: header pin 2: part says OUT, datasheet reading says Yellow (OUT)
diffs.evidence: Same pin under a colour+function label. YF-S401 datasheet wiring table, verbatim: 'Red : IN positive / Yellow : OUT signal output / Black : GND negative'. The part names the yellow lead by its function, OUT.

diffs.diff: flow rate (L/min), raw = pulse frequency in Hz: datasheet reading gives 0.0102040816 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: Same conversion, inverted. YF-S401 datasheet, verbatim: 'Flow pulse characteristics F = (98 * Q) ± 2% Q = L / MIN'. The part is a pulse-sensor with sim.pulse.hzPerUnit = 98 (F = 98 x Q), which publish.ts does not parse as a conversion; the reading's 1/98 = 0.0102040816 L/min per Hz is the same relation.
